intro1: Oundle’s limestone houses and Georgian frontages deserve joinery made with the same care, so we build around the room, not around standard units.
intro2: That lets us respect period details and make the most of older rooms, while still giving you the clean, modern finish many Oundle homeowners want. The same Peterborough team designs, makes and fits every piece, about 13 miles away at Brassey Close.
sty: Eaves wardrobes in a cottage bedroom, a larder run in a small stone kitchen or a desk in the spare room: each piece is drawn for the space it’s going into.
proc_lead: Making takes four to six weeks once you approve the design. Oundle is about 25 minutes away on the A605, so survey and fitting days are simple to book.
steps: We measure in detail, noting uneven stone walls, deep window reveals, low beams and how big a piece can be to get up your stairs. Free, with no obligation.
You see the room in 3D before anything is made, with a quote that lists every item.
Larger runs are built in sections in our workshop so they fit through narrow doorways and up tight staircases.
Our fitters assemble and finish everything on site, using the right fixings for thick stone walls and old ceilings.
bk: Send a few photos on WhatsApp or book a visit. We’ll come to your Oundle home, measure up and send you a 3D design with an itemised quote, free and with no obligation.
det: Our showroom and workshop are in Peterborough, around 13 miles from Oundle. As well as the town itself, we design and fit in Barnwell, Ashton, Cotterstock and Fotheringhay. We cover homes up to 80 miles from Peterborough, so if you’re further out, call 01733 686767 and we’ll tell you straight away.
faqs: How far is Oundle from your workshop?

About 13 miles, usually 25 minutes along the A605. We work in Oundle and the villages around it regularly, so visits are easy to arrange and our fitters can get back quickly for any adjustments after handover.
Can you get fitted furniture into an old stone cottage?
Yes. Low beams and tight staircases limit how big each piece can be, so we plan for that from the start and build larger runs in sections that we assemble in the room.
Do I need permission for fitted furniture in Oundle’s conservation area?

The furniture itself usually doesn’t need consent. Work that touches original fabric in a listed or older building, such as removing a wall or altering a fireplace, may do. We flag anything like that at the survey so you can check with North Northamptonshire Council.
What does a fitted kitchen cost?
Straightforward fitted kitchens start from around £5,000, and larger kitchens with stone worktops, appliances and more storage cost more. You get an itemised quote after the free survey.
Can I visit your showroom from Oundle?
Yes. We’re at 3 Brassey Close, Peterborough PE1 2AZ, about 25 minutes from Oundle. Call 01733 686767 to arrange a time.
